name: Bakery: 13-week shortfall with an MCA offer, a line of credit, 2/10 net 30 flour invoices and an SBA 7(a) working-capital loan. The MCA cannot be refinanced with SBA proceeds (SBA SOP 50 10 8/8.1), so it is not prepayable here.

baseline.label: take the full $50,000 MCA you were offered

note: The model pools all cash in one account and cannot enforce use-of-proceeds rules. Check every SBA-funded plan with the lender: proceeds may be used for working capital, not to pay off merchant cash advances.
